correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim, every legal graph edge is exactly a swap of consecutive positions whose endpoint also belongs to the full derangement list. The fresh verifier enumerates all n! words at n=2,...,5, filters by the literal fixed-point condition, computes exact BFS distances and compares to the Kendall pair-disagreement count for every reachable unordered pair. I executed it: vertex counts 1,2,9,44; respective reachable pair counts 0,0,11,188; no detours. Independently reasoned the upper and lower bounds for all n>=6. The displayed path acts in the first five positions and its eight prefixes have no fixed point; T_n=(7,...,n,4) is fixed throughout and has no fixed point even at n=6. Only five pair orders change between the endpoints: 1 with 2,5,6 and 6 with 2,5. Each step on an unrestricted geodesic would decrease disagreement by one. The only decreasing first swaps are (1,2) and (5,6) as label pairs, which respectively fix positions 2 and 5; no tail swap decreases disagreement. Every path length has odd parity, and the seven legal prefix swaps reach the target, proving exact distances 7 and 5 even when additional tail moves are allowed. Fresh BFS also independently confirmed those distances at n=6. Verification front matter is byte-identical to the original.
residual_risks: Small-order isometry is certified only through order 5. The general proof constructs witness pairs; it is not an all-pairs formula or a maximum-detour statement.

value.rationale: Once exact connectivity of the signature sectors is known, it is natural to ask whether standard Kendall geodesics already suffice for optimal routing within them. The answer is not a trivial consequence of disconnectedness: every connected pair retains its distance through order five, while a concrete local obstruction first forces a two-step surcharge at six and cannot be bypassed using extra labels at any larger order. The exact boundary and persistence make the witness independently useful, rather than retaining a covered theorem with a cosmetic disclaimer.
residual_risks: The repaired result does not quantify the worst surcharge at large order, or address moves other than consecutive-position swaps.
